title: Changes in the Doctor- and Nurse-to-Population Ratios
what_it_is: Changes in the Doctor- and Nurse-to-Population Ratios

sections.label: Nurse staffing ratios compared
sections.summary: Singapore has 69 nurses per 10,000 population, compared to 66 in Hong Kong and 60 in Taiwan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For nurses, we have 69 nurses per 10,000 population compared to 66 in Hong Kong and 60 in Taiwan.

sections.label: Healthcare 2020 Masterplan workforce growth
sections.summary: MOH is expanding healthcare and aged care capacity, on track to grow the healthcare workforce by 20,000 between 2011 and 2020, with rising demand and a smaller local workforce beyond 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH has been expanding the capacity of our healthcare and aged care services in Singapore under the Healthcare 2020 Masterplan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are on track to growing the healthcare workforce by 20,000 between 2011 and 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Looking beyond 2020, Singapore will face an increase in projected healthcare demand and also a smaller local workforce due to our ageing population.

sections.label: Not fixating on staffing ratio
sections.summary: The speaker says this will continue and tells Mr Perera not to be overly fixated on the staffing ratio, as it is only one dimension of quality healthcare.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: This is something which we will continue to do.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: It is important for us to look beyond the numbers and I need to re-emphasise this point to Mr Perera, that we should not be overly fixated on one particular number, the staffing ratio, because it only represents one dimension of quality healthcare.

sections.label: Improving work environment, mid-career support
sections.summary: Efforts continue with hospitals, healthcare institutions and unions to improve the work environment so healthcare workers can work to a later age, and mid-career professionals get funded training, allowances and a career transition bonus.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, part of the effort that we have been working on and we will continue to do, is to work closely with the hospitals, the healthcare institutions and also our unions to look at how we can improve the work environment to allow our healthcare workers to work till a later age.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We are also looking at supporting mid-career professionals who are interested to become healthcare workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We will fund the cost of their training and provide them with training allowances during their studies to help defray their living expenses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: And upon completing their training, they will receive a career transition bonus.

sections.label: Grants awarded as of March 2015
sections.summary: As of March 2015, 630 of such grants have been awarded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As of March 2015, we have awarded 630 of such grants.
